checks: validate and verify every work_review_transition_v1 signature
link project, root, authority and child identifiers
require frozen_request_digest and exact_request_commitment to match the challenged child
require review_evidence_hash to identify Keel's immutable exact-request review artifact
require final decision and status to match the terminal child state
require a review-resume Policy snapshot for an approved request
require no dispatch-boundary evidence when final_decision is deny
body.approval_rule: human approval permits re-evaluation only and can validly end in denial
non_claims: does not establish the natural-person identity behind actor_id
does not turn approval into authorization
does not establish dispatch or external outcome
